item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (72)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 72

  • Scenes opens as a full page, with the list on one side and the frame on the other.
  • Show can select the filtered photos, then move, cut, delete, or archive them.
  • A soft frame says whether Clarity can sharpen it.
  • A folder inside a drive is listed once.
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes
